_meta.purpose: Corrections for stops the atlas feeds geocode to the wrong place, plus the list of flagged-but-correct stops that lets the audit gate a build.
_meta.appliedBy: scripts/fix-port-locations.mjs (npm run fix:ports) — idempotent, re-run after every feed refresh

fields.name: the stop name exactly as the feed writes it
fields.collections: which feeds this entry applies to; omit for all
fields.was: the wrong coordinate, as a guard — an entry only fires on a stop within TOLERANCE_DEG of it, so a feed that changes its mind is reported instead of silently overwritten
fields.ll: the corrected [lat, lng]; null means 'true location unknown, ship it with no coordinate rather than a spike'
fields.scope: 'occurrence' applies the fix only where it moves the stop closer to its neighbours — for names that are two real places (San Sebastián in Gipuzkoa and in La Gomera)
fields.why: the evidence, so the next person can disagree with it
fields.source: where the corrected coordinate came from
